title: Jon Stewart on Crossfire
summary: Jon Stewart appears as a guest on CNN's Crossfire in 2004 and criticizes hosts Tucker Carlson and Paul Begala for turning political debate into partisan theater that hurts America.
why: HN returns to it constantly as the definitive critique of adversarial TV punditry, still seen as relevant to polarized media and online discourse.

quote.text: It's so very worth watching again even if you've seen it multiple times.
